headline: A BEAUTY BRAND PUT A 57-MINUTE DOCUMENTARY ON YOUTUBE, DID 371,600 VIEWS, AND HAS ALREADY GREENLIT SEASON TWO.  THE VIEW COUNT IS NOT WHY
deck: Most agencies would call that number a miss on a film that long.  The brand funded it out of the budget it normally spends buying reach, built the whole thing in-house, and will not say what it cost.  Read it as a media decision rather than a content decision and every part of it makes sense.
tldr: Cakes put a 57-minute documentary on its own YouTube channel on 22 September, did more than 371,600 views, and has a second season in development — funded from the brand-marketing budget, built in-house for control, with the cost undisclosed.  Rewrite your next owned-video business case as a cost-per-reach comparison against the paid media it would displace over twelve months, and put a floor view number in writing before you start.

CreatorIQ's survey of 2,000 marketers found only 52 percent of growing creator budgets came out of paid media this year, down from 64 percent, with 38 percent now coming from new funding.  Find out which of those two your next creator budget is, then build a head-to-head comparison if it is carved out of media, and a written worst-acceptable-outcome if it is new money.

ShopMy launched a product that runs a creator's already-posted organic video as paid media, alongside Meta's reported 13 percent click-through advantage for creator-led partnership ads and TikTok's claim of about 25 percent for Spark Ads.  Pull every organic post that mentions your brand from creators you have already paid, rank them by the engagement their own channel got, and take the top five in as candidate paid assets.

Minecraft LIVE took more than 694,000 peak concurrent viewers across 279 channels, and the publisher's own YouTube channel held about 367,000 of them — more than every co-streamer combined.  Decide in writing whether your next brand livestream carries information or reaction, and if it is information, spend on driving traffic to your own feed rather than on co-streaming fees.

EA Sports FC 27 did 29 million hours watched from over 52,700 channels in ten days, and one German creator carried 1.7 million of them on his own, with sponsored streams at just 2.33 percent of the total.  Get the top five channels by hours watched on any launch you are buying into, work out what share they carry, and negotiate those five individually from the tail.

Caraway has spent eight months answering a February lawsuit in its own channels — 50,000 petition signatures, billboards outside the plaintiff's office, videos on LinkedIn — and has published no lift data, while the one academic in the story says regulator debunking is the only source with a statistically significant effect across categories.  When a client is under a public claim, spend the first month getting an independent test or certification on the record and build the video around that document.

Advertising Week has set a target of brokering 100 million dollars of creator deals across 5 to 8 October with no published counting method, against the 44 billion dollars the same piece says the United States spends on creator advertising this year — roughly twenty hours of national spend.  Get into the organiser's matching process before the weekend if you have budget to place, and ask what counted as a deal when the figure appears in a deck next week.
